answers.why: All Israel hears Solomon's judgment and fears the king.
Solomon reigns over all Israel as its king.
Solomon's twelve officers administer all Israel and provide for his household.
Manasseh is named as Jair's ancestor in the phrase 'Jair the son of Manasseh.'
Ahimaaz serves in Naphtali's tribal territory.
Baanah serves in Asher's tribal territory and Aloth.
Jehoshaphat serves in Issachar's tribal territory.
Shimei serves in Benjamin's tribal territory.
Judah is a multitude eating, drinking, and rejoicing under Solomon.
Israel is numerous as the sand, eating, drinking, and rejoicing.
Judah's inhabitants dwell safely under their vines and fig trees during Solomon's reign.
Israel's inhabitants dwell safely from Dan to Beersheba during Solomon's reign.
